sloka: अकामा तेन यस्मात्त्वं बलाद्भद्रे प्रधर्षिता ।तस्मात्स युवतीमन्यां नाकामामुपयास्यति ।। ७.२६.५६ ॥
transliteration: akāmā tena yasmāttvaṁ balādbhadre pradharṣitā ।tasmātsa yuvatīmanyāṁ nākāmāmupayāsyati ।। 7.26.56 ॥

translations.english: O auspicious one, because you were molested by him by force against your will, therefore he will not approach another young woman who is unwilling.
